**Describe the bug**

**Version Details**
Please go to the credits screen and press select. This will bring up a menu with debug information- please add a screenshot of that menu here.

**Save Files**
If you have save file backups of both games from right before you started a transfer, please attach them here. Save files from after the transfer can be helpful, but are not as important.
